Job Title: Enterprise Power BI Reporting Intern

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Department: Information Technology

Reports to: Manager, Data & Technical Integration

GENERAL DESCRIPTION / PURPOSE:

The Enterprise Power BI Reporting Intern supports the Enterprise Data & Analytics team in developing, enhancing, and administering enterprise reporting solutions using Microsoft Power BI. This position provides hands-on experience in business intelligence, report development, semantic modeling, reporting governance, and Power BI administration while contributing to real enterprise initiatives.

Working alongside data engineers, business analysts, and report developers, the intern will assist in the development of an enterprise Power BI application and help establish the standards that support Loram's modern reporting platform. The role offers exposure to enterprise data architecture, business intelligence best practices, and modern analytics technologies while building practical skills that prepare the student for a career in analytics, business intelligence, or application development.

ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:

- Develop Power BI reports, dashboards, and applications that support enterprise reporting needs.
- Assist in the design, testing, deployment, and maintenance of Power BI reporting solutions.
- Support the development and documentation of semantic models, datasets, business metrics, and DAX measures.
- Assist in developing reporting governance practices, including report certification, semantic model standards, security, and lifecycle management.
- Support Power BI administration activities, including workspace management, report deployment, dataset refreshes, and environment organization.
- Validate report accuracy through testing and data reconciliation.
- Work with business users to gather requirements, test solutions, and support report enhancements.
- Create technical and end-user documentation to support reporting standards and governance.
- Learn and apply enterprise data management, reporting, and business intelligence best practices while contributing to strategic analytics initiatives. ​​​​

INTERNSHIP PROJECT:

The intern will participate in the development of an enterprise Power BI application while helping establish the foundation for Loram's enterprise reporting platform.

Project activities may include:

- Developing dashboards and interactive reports.
- Designing report navigation and user experiences.
- Assisting with semantic model development and documentation.
- Supporting report testing and validation.
- Organizing Power BI workspaces and reporting assets.
- Creating documentation for reporting standards and governance.
- Assisting with report deployment and lifecycle management.
- Participating in demonstrations and gathering business feedback.

Qualifications

Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Software or Application Development, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Management Information Systems, or a related field.

Experience:

- Junior or Senior standing with an expected graduation date within two years.
- Working knowledge of Microsoft Power BI.
- Basic understanding of SQL and relational databases.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
- Eagerness to learn enterprise reporting, analytics, and business intelligence technologies.

Preferred Qualifications:

- Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) certification or actively preparing for certification.
- Coursework or project experience in Power BI report development and data visualization.
- Experience with DAX, Power Query, or data modeling concepts.
- Familiarity with data warehousing, semantic models, or business intelligence principles.
- Experience with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric is a plus.
- Knowledge of source control or software development practices.
- Experience developing class, personal, or internship projects using Power BI or SQL.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

- Office deskwork, requiring sitting, walking, using phone & computer

Loram is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and respectful workplace. Your Impact at LILA

Lila is looking for a fall co-op to support the Enterprise Go-to-Market team as we build more proactive, structured, and data-informed ways to prioritize customer opportunities. This role will sit close to enterprise, product marketing, and commercial workflows, helping the team turn customer signals, competitive intelligence, CRM data, and market research into clearer enablement systems.

The co-op will support projects across opportunity prioritization, customer segmentation, competitive research, and sales tooling. They will help organize information, improve how the team tracks and acts on market signals, and contribute to practical resources that make enterprise GTM work more focused and repeatable.

This is a good fit for someone who is curious about B2B go-to-market strategy, product marketing, revenue operations, and AI-enabled commercial systems. The work will be hands-on and cross-functional, with exposure to how Lila identifies priority customers, supports strategic deals, and builds the operating tools needed for a fast-growing enterprise team.

What You'll Be Building

- Support research on customer segmentation, opportunity prioritization, and strategic account focus areas.

- Help organize customer, market, and CRM data into usable GTM enablement resources.

- Synthesize signals from customer conversations, market research, and internal data into clear briefs and summaries.

- Build lightweight tools, trackers, and workflows that make GTM execution more proactive, including competitive intelligence resources for the AI-for-science landscape.

- Contribute to research-backed sales and product marketing materials for enterprise audiences.

- Help clarify how Lila’s platform differs from point-solution AI tools, CRO-style approaches, lab automation vendors, scientific software, and model-only providers.

- Identify ways AI tools and agentic workflows can improve team productivity, insight generation, and prioritization.

What You'll Need to Succeed

- Currently enrolled in an MBA program.

- Strong interest in enterprise go-to-market, product marketing, revenue operations, or commercial strategy.

- High comfort using AI tools to research, structure information, and improve day-to-day workflows.

- Able to synthesize messy inputs into clear briefs, trackers, summaries, or recommendations.

- Strong written communication skills, with attention to clarity, structure, and audience.

- Comfortable working across commercial, product marketing, and technical stakeholders.

- Organized, proactive, and able to manage multiple small projects with clear follow-through.

Bonus Points For

- Experience in B2B software, enterprise technology, AI, or model-provider environments.

- Familiarity with CRM tools, GTM tooling, market research, or customer segmentation.

- Interest in AI for science, scientific software, lab automation, or technical commercialization.

- Technical academic background in life sciences, physical sciences, engineering, computer science, or a related field.

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy.

A Note to Agencies

Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.
